project.title: Microsoft Scout: Agentic Workflow Copilot
project.tagline: An AI-powered agentic copilot that orchestrates tools, MCP servers, Microsoft 365 context, and workflow automation to help people move from intent to action faster.

problemStatement: Knowledge workers and support teams lose time translating intent into action across disconnected systems. Scout explores how an agentic AI copilot can coordinate tools, context, and workflows to complete reviewable work safely and efficiently.
approach: Scout was taught repeatable skills and workflows across Microsoft 365, support operations, documents, dashboards, browser automation, case management, and business process automation.
